rv: I loved the story when I read it. I've loved most of the films made of it (one exception was a comedy version with Richard Chamberlain, but that was fun in it's way as well) but this is absolutely the best version. The one with Stuart Granger and Deborah Kerr was great but this one is closer to the book and more realistic except for Paul Robeson's singing, which is great but unnecessary to the story.
This movie is very well directed. The cast did an excellent work in thier perfomances. For those who like to go back in time through movies this is an excellent master piece.
This is one truly fine adventure movie. I highly recommended it.

One of my pet peeves is why movie people always have to play with a perfectly good story. The whole thing with the O'Briens was so lame. Curtis and Good were lot bigger parts of the story than they got credit for. But in many ways this movie followed the book plot better than other adaptations.
